## About
Mygrant Glass Company is a family-owned auto glass wholesaler. Our focus is simple: good service and a wide inventory for the shops and installers who buy from us.
Our Doral branch sits at 3505 NW 107th Ave and is open Monday through Saturday. Existing customers can get price quotes and place orders on our website, or call the branch to order.
Customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 36 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto glass from a family-owned wholesaler: Auto glass parts supplied to shops and installers, backed by a wide inventory.
- Price quotes and orders on our website: Existing customers can check real-time price quotes and place orders on our website.
- Tools and accessories: Search our supply catalog for the tools and accessories you need for the job.

## FAQ
Q: How do I place an order?
A: Existing customers can order on our website. Right now we also ask that you call in your orders to the branch.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No. The Doral branch is closed on Sunday and open Monday through Saturday.

Q: Do you share my contact information?
A: No. Mygrant Glass does not sell or pass along your identity or contact details.
